title: Always On My Mind - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach West,FL | 30a Escapes
meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents… Always On My Mind - a dreamy oceanfront Seacrest West retreat where every moment feels like paradise. Wake up to panoramic Gulf views, sip coffee on the balcony, or relax by your private pool. Stroll to the sugar-white sand just steps away.
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… Always On My Mind - a dreamy oceanfront Seacrest West retreat where every moment feels like paradise. Wake up to panoramic Gulf views, sip coffee on the balcony, or relax by your private pool. Stroll to the sugar-white sand just steps away. This 5-Suite retreat offers space to gather in the main house or cozy carriage house. Cook in the gourmet kitchen, share laughs at the dining table, and end nights under the stars. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***INCREDIBLE Gulf Views – Enjoy uninterrupted Gulf views, perfect for any time of the day and occasion.Private Pool with Lounge Chairs – Relax by your own serene pool with chaise lounges, ideal for soaking up the sun or cooling off.Exclusive Beach Boardwalk Access – A short walk takes you straight to the sandy shores for effortless beach days.4 Beach Chairs + 2 Umbrellas Included (March–October) – Complimentary chairs and umbrellas are ready for you on the beach.Main House + Carriage House – Plenty of space with a detached carriage house for extra privacy, great for hosting family or friends.Gourmet Kitchen Overlooking the Gulf – Cook with high-end appliances and stunning Gulf views for a memorable experience.Sleeps 12 in 5 Suites – Rest easy in plush, thoughtfully designed bedrooms with en-suites for your group.Close to Shopping & Restaurants – Boutique shops and renowned dining are just moments away.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “Right on the beach. Amazing views and perfect for families!” – Bill B.⭐ “The perfect house and location for our group! Already booked for next year.” – Carrie M.⭐ “Loved having private beach access and the poolside lounge area.” – Linda T.*** LIVING AREAS ***Relax in the elegant living spaces with floor-to-ceiling windows offering panoramic Gulf views. The open layout includes a plush seating area and a flat-screen TV, perfect for cozy evenings.Gulf-Front Living Area with Plush Seating, Smart TVAccess to the large furnished balcony with stunning views1st Floor Den with Comfortable Seating, Smart TV, and Direct Pool Deck AccessCarriage House Living Area with Cozy Seating and Entertainment Options*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook and dine in style! The gourmet kitchen features premium appliances, ample counter space, and a dining table for eight, complemented by a Gulf-view outdoor dining area. Plus, the carriage house includes a convenient kitchenette for added flexibility.Gourmet Kitchen with High-End AppliancesDining Table for 8 Guests, plus bistro table for 2 and 2 seats at the kitchen islandOutdoor Teak Dining Area for 4 with Gulf ViewsKitchenette at the Carriage House*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Spend your days by the private pool or take the boardwalk to the pristine beach. The outdoor space is perfect for sunbathing, grilling, or simply enjoying the coastal breeze.Private Seasonally Heated Pool (September - April)Poolside Deck with Loungers in secluded area between Main and Carriage Houses1st Floor Patio - Custom Swing, Teak Chairs and Ample Green Space for Gulf-Front RelaxationOutdoor Grill and Dining Area on the 1st floor patio2nd Floor Balcony - Enhanced with Gulf Views for perfect sunsets and sunrisesPrivate Beach Access via Boardwalk*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Primary Suite: King Bed, En-Suite Bath with Walk-In Shower + Handrails for guests with limited mobilityHalf Bath Conveniently Located Near Living Spaces2nd Floor:Full Guest Suite: Two Full Beds (Sleeps 4), Private Bath with Shower-Tub ComboTwin Guest Suite: Two Twin Beds, Access to the Gulf Front Balcony, Private Bath with Shower-Tub ComboPrimary Suite: King Bed with balcony access, En-Suite Bath with Walk-In ShowerCarriage House:Queen Bedroom, Living Area, Kitchenette, and Full Bathroom*** ADDITIONAL HOME PERKS ***Elevator for easy access to all floorsDedicated workspace for remote work or studyingHigh-speed Wi-Fi for seamless connectivityWasher and dryer for guest convenience7 beach bikes available for your use to explore 30A2 Complimentary beach setups included—enjoy 4 loungers and 2 umbrellas ready for you on the beach (Beach Chair Service available 3/6 - 10/31)*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in Seacrest West, Always On My Mind puts you at the heart of the action, with easy access to boutique shopping, top-notch restaurants, and the iconic, serene 30A beaches.Alys Beach - Just a 3-minute drive, this chic, whitewashed paradise exudes luxury and sophistication, perfect for a leisurely stroll or a photo-worthy moment.Rosemary Beach - A quick 5-minute drive brings you to this charming, European-inspired coastal village, buzzing with quaint shops, vibrant eateries, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.The Big Chill - Located nearby (1.5 miles away), this lively entertainment and dining hub is the perfect spot to unwind, enjoy live music, and savor delicious food with friends and family.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.The private pool is heated between September 1 - April 30.Enjoy 2 complimentary beach set-ups with your stay, including 4 loungers and 2 umbrellas. Available from 3/6 to 10/31.This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 81064STRO #: STR-081064
